en.hubeali: From him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Usman Bin Isa, from Sama’at who said,
‘Do not pray Salāt in stalls of the cavalry horses, and the mules and the donkeys’.
en.sarwar: 3. It is a narration from him (narrator of previous Hadith) by Ahmad ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from Sama‘ah who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said, ‘
You must not perform Salah (prayer) in places where horses, mules and donkeys are kept.’”
